1.title: The Last Anchorage
1.premise: An ordinary person transported to an archipelago of moving islands joins the crew of a stranded town. A progression system lets people change how structures hold together, and the protagonist wants to free the town before its island enters a destructive current. Invent the people, rules, opposition and choices. Write a self-contained first volume of 24 chapters in four six-chapter arcs, approximately 2200 words per chapter. The first request covers only chapters 1-6. Resolve the town's immediate predicament and the protagonist's commitment to its people by the end of chapter 24, allowing consequences and a denouement. The wider world may continue beyond this volume. This is one story with a conclusion, not four restarts.
